meta_description:
18K likes, 550 comments - kaisafit on October 18, 2026: "What is she trying to tell me…

Maybe it’s nothing & I’m just looking for signs everywhere I possibly can 😂✨ but this is the 2nd time in a few days that a hawk came to visit. I don’t know why she’s visiting me but it feels so special & I’m sticking with the fact that it’s some kind of good sign 🙌

And if you know birds & signs and what it all might mean please let me know! (but only if it’s positive, I can’t handle a bird coming to tell me some negative sh*t right now 😩😂)".
